items.title: Login SSO
items.desc: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-messaging-shell
items.title: Messaging Shell
items.desc: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-payment-form
items.title: Checkout Form
items.desc: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then ca…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-product-detail
items.title: Product Detail
items.desc: Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.desc: Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price. Browse-to-select only, with no filtering and no detail surface.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-settings
items.title: Settings Form
items.desc: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them. The simplest settings shape: everything reachable by scrolling.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.desc: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath. Grouped toggles, live preview of appearance choices, rebindable shortcuts.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-settings-sidebar
items.title: Settings Panels
items.desc: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-shell-side-nav
items.title: Side Nav
items.desc: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content. Vertical navigation only, no top bar.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-collapsible
items.title: Collapsible Table
items.desc: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns - for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells. One time range drives them all, and rows expand into…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-comparison
items.title: Comparison Table
items.desc: Transposed matrix that puts candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column that survives horizontal scroll, columns you can swap or add, and best-in-row marks you can toggle. Compare,…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-filter
items.title: Filterable Table
items.desc: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-grouped
items.title: Grouped Table
items.desc: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row.
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-inbox
items.title: Inbox Table
items.desc: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; rep…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-page
items.title: Searchable Table
items.desc: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once - a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers - with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail,…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-table-tree
items.title: Tree Table
items.desc: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children - a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README. Columns resize, siblings sort wi…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: template-work-item-detail
items.title: Work Item Detail
items.desc: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail wi…
items.author: Astryx

items.name: ai-prompt
items.title: AI Input Selector
items.desc: AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying.

items.name: card-flip
items.title: Flick Card
items.desc: A two-sided card you spin with a drag or a flick, with thickness, light and a floor shadow that follow the angle.

items.name: smooth-drawer
items.title: Smooth Drawer
items.desc: Checkout bottom sheet on Vaul snap points, peeking at the total and dragging up for details.

items.name: halftone-background
items.title: Halftone Background
items.desc: Any image, or a lit sphere, printed as a halftone dot screen, with a loupe that looks closer under the cursor, built with React and canvas.

items.name: shape-hero
items.title: Shape Hero
items.desc: A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown.

items.name: ai-text-loading
items.title: AI Text Loading
items.desc: AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter.

items.name: carousel-cards
items.title: Momentum Rail
items.desc: A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.desc: A multi-file upload queue with per-file progress, retry and cancel.

items.name: ai-input-search
items.title: AI Input Search
items.desc: AI composer with a Tools menu (browse, investigate, draft, run code, reason), a model picker and a live trace that stacks each source's avatar as it is read.

items.name: cradle-text
items.title: Cradle Text
items.desc: A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics.

items.name: currency-transfer
items.title: Currency Transfer
items.desc: Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail and ends with a copyable reference.

items.name: background-paths
items.title: Background Paths
items.desc: A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.desc: A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas.

items.name: topo-background
items.title: Topo Background
items.desc: A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas.

items.name: drape-background
items.title: Drape Background
items.desc: A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation.

items.name: apple-activity-card
items.title: Apple Activity Card
items.desc: Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion.

items.name: ai-voice
items.title: AI Voice
items.desc: Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send.

items.name: smooth-tab
items.title: Swipe Tabs
items.desc: Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics.

items.name: team-selector
items.title: Team Selector
items.desc: Seat picker with a scrubbable number, generated avatars and an optional rolling price line.

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.desc: Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion.

items.name: liquid-slider
items.title: Liquid Slider
items.desc: A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles.

items.name: pull-cord
items.title: Pull Cord
items.desc: A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation.

items.name: tear-button
items.title: Tear Button
items.desc: A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole.

items.name: bell-button
items.title: Bell Button
items.desc: A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Widget Grid
items.desc: Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.desc: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that drains back on early release and a drawn check on completion.

items.name: attract-button
items.title: Magnet Button
items.desc: A call-to-action button wrapped in a field of iron filings that align to its magnetic field and lean toward your cursor.

items.name: gradient-button
items.title: Gradient Button
items.desc: Layered gradient button with emerald, purple and orange variants, a gradient border, a soft inner glow, press feedback and an optional icon.

items.name: v0-button
items.title: V0 Button
items.desc: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: ai-loading
items.title: AI State Loading
items.desc: Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done.

items.name: ai-tool-approval
items.title: AI Tool Approval
items.desc: Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output.

items.name: ai-citations
items.title: AI Inline Citations
items.desc: An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs.

items.name: ai-diff-review
items.title: AI Diff Review
items.desc: A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo.

items.name: ai-model-selector
items.title: AI Model Selector
items.desc: Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Throw Deck
items.desc: A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view.
